images.title: 36 pouches, 4 rows of 9 and the same pouches turned
images.purpose: Show that the same 36 pouches packed as 4 rows of 9 turn into 9 rows of 4, so the number of groups and the group size swap places and the total stays 36.
images.composition: A 4 by 9 array on the left, a turn arrow, and a 9 by 4 array on the right, each with its caption and its number sentence below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two arrays of butter milk pouches with a turn arrow between them. Every pouch is the same rounded rectangle (corner radius 8 px), 48 px wide and 40 px tall, filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and no marking on it; neighbouring pouches are 12 px apart across and down. LEFT array: exactly 36 pouches in 4 rows of 9 columns, top left corner at x 220 and y 282, spanning x 220 to 748 and y 282 to 478. RIGHT array: exactly 36 pouches in 9 rows of 4 columns, top left corner at x 976 and y 152, spanning x 976 to 1204 and y 152 to 608. Between the arrays, centred at y 380, one grey #6B7280 curved arrow (5 px line, pointing right) from x 790 to x 930, with the word Turn centred above it at x 860 and y 330 in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px). Under the left array, centred at x 484: the caption 4 rows of 9 at y 540 (40 px dark) and the sentence 4 × 9 = 36 at y 600 (52 px bold dark). Under the right array, centred at x 1090: the caption 9 rows of 4 at y 680 (40 px dark) and the sentence 9 × 4 = 36 at y 740 (52 px bold dark). In all there are 72 pouches, none shaded, none missing. No other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a left array with a number of pouches other than 36 or an arrangement other than 4 rows of 9
a right array with a number of pouches other than 36 or an arrangement other than 9 rows of 4
images.takeaway: Turning the picture swaps the number of groups and the group size, and the 36 pouches stay the same.
images.description: Two arrays of 36 butter milk pouches, 4 rows of 9 and 9 rows of 4, with a turn arrow between them.
images.context: Concept image for Equal Groups: Many Ways to Make a Total. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (the same pouches packed in equal rows) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example: 36 pouches.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student count the rows and the pouches in a row of each array and see that the total is 36 both times. The slip to watch: thinking that 4 rows of 9 and 9 rows of 4 are different totals.

image_decisions.why: The two arrays of 36 pouches make equal groups countable and show the turn, which words alone do not.
